daas-irab:1-1.t: ﴿وَيْلٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); ﴿لِلْمُطَفِّفِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:2-2.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: badal (substitute) for المطففين; ﴿إِذَا﴾: a conditional adverb that does not put the verb in the jussive; ﴿اكْتالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of a genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); ﴿عَلَى النَّاسِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) what precedes them; ﴿يَسْتَوْفُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), the wāw being its agent; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:3-3.t: ﴿وَإِذا﴾: conjoined to the first إذا; ﴿كالُوهُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is in the position of a genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction; ﴿وَزَنُوهُمْ﴾: conjoined to كالوهم. ﴿يُخْسِرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), the wāw being its agent; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:4-4.t: ﴿أَلا﴾: the hamza is an interrogative particle and ﴿لا﴾ is negative; ﴿يَظُنُّ﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ); ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: fāʿil (agent); ﴿أَنَّهُمْ مَبْعُوثُونَ﴾: anna, its noun and its khabar (predicate); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from anna and what follows it stands in place of the two objects of يظن.

daas-irab:5-5.t: ﴿لِيَوْمٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) مبعوثون; ﴿عَظِيمٍ﴾: naʿt (adjective).

daas-irab:6-6.t: ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time; ﴿يَقُومُ النَّاسُ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of a genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); ﴿لِرَبِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

daas-irab:7-7.t: ﴿كَلَّا﴾: a particle of deterrence and rebuke; ﴿إِنَّ كِتابَ﴾: inna and its noun, muḍāf to ﴿الفُجَّارِ﴾, which is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿لَفِي﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿في سِجِّينٍ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of inna; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:8-8.t: ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle and ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿أَدْراكَ﴾: a past verb and its object, the fāʿil (agent) being latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿ما سِجِّينٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ and its khabar; the clause stands in place of the second object of أدراك.

daas-irab:9-9.t: ﴿كِتابٌ﴾: badal (substitute) for سجين; ﴿مَرْقُومٌ﴾: naʿt (adjective) of كتاب.

daas-irab:10-10.t: ﴿وَيْلٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾: an adverb of time annexed to one like it; ﴿لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:11-11.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: naʿt (adjective) of المكذبين; ﴿يُكَذِّبُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين; ﴿بِيَوْمِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; ﴿الدِّينِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

daas-irab:12-12.t: ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and ﴿ما﴾ is negative; ﴿يُكَذِّبُ﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ); ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿كُلُّ﴾: fāʿil (agent), muḍāf to ﴿مُعْتَدٍ﴾; ﴿أَثِيمٍ﴾: naʿt (adjective); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:13-13.t: ﴿إِذا﴾: a conditional adverb that does not put the verb in the jussive; ﴿تُتْلى﴾: a passive imperfect verb; ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; ﴿آياتُنا﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of a genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) and has no grammatical position; ﴿أَساطِيرُ﴾: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the nominal clause is the maqūl (speech content) of the saying.

daas-irab:14-14.t: ﴿كَلَّا﴾: a particle of deterrence and rebuke; ﴿بَلْ﴾: a particle of transition and digression (iḍrāb); ﴿رانَ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; ﴿عَلى قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; ﴿ما﴾: the fāʿil (agent) of ران; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿كانُوا﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the wāw being its noun; ﴿يَكْسِبُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), the wāw being its agent; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of kāna, and the clause كانوا… is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما.

daas-irab:15-15.t: ﴿كَلَّا﴾: a particle of deterrence and rebuke; ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾: inna and its noun; ﴿عَنْ رَبِّهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾: an adverb of time annexed to one like it; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position; ﴿لَمَحْجُوبُونَ﴾: the khabar, with the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).

daas-irab:16-16.t: ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction; ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾: inna and its noun, and the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿صالوا﴾: the khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw, the nūn having been dropped for annexation (iḍāfa); ﴿الْجَحِيمِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:17-17.t: ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction; ﴿يُقالُ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) being latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿هذَا الَّذِي﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: kāna and its noun; ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) what follows them; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause); ﴿تُكَذِّبُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ) and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar of كنتم.

daas-irab:18-18.t: ﴿كَلَّا﴾: a particle of deterrence and rebuke; ﴿إِنَّ كِتابَ﴾: inna and its noun, muḍāf to ﴿الْأَبْرارِ﴾, which is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿لَفِي﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿في عِلِّيِّينَ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of inna; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:20-20.t: Parsed like verse no. 9; مرقوم is an adjective of كتاب.

daas-irab:21-21.t: ﴿يَشْهَدُهُ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object; ﴿الْمُقَرَّبُونَ﴾: fāʿil (agent); the clause is a second naʿt (adjective) of كتاب.

daas-irab:22-22.t: ﴿إِنَّ الْأَبْرارَ﴾: inna and its noun; ﴿لَفِي﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿في نَعِيمٍ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of inna; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:23-23.t: ﴿عَلَى الْأَرائِكِ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) what follows them; ﴿يَنْظُرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:24-24.t: ﴿تَعْرِفُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); ﴿فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; ﴿نَضْرَةَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), muḍāf to ﴿النَّعِيمِ﴾; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:25-25.t: ﴿يُسْقَوْنَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, the wāw being the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿مِنْ رَحِيقٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; ﴿مَخْتُومٍ﴾: naʿt (adjective); the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:26-26.t: ﴿خِتامُهُ مِسْكٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is a second naʿt (adjective) of رحيق. ﴿وَفِي﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle; ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) what follows them; ﴿فَلْيَتَنافَسِ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command; ﴿الْمُتَنافِسُونَ﴾: fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:27-27.t: ﴿وَمِزاجُهُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿مِنْ تَسْنِيمٍ﴾: its khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:28-28.t: ﴿عَيْناً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "أمدح" (I praise); ﴿يَشْرَبُ﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ); ﴿بِهَا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; ﴿الْمُقَرَّبُونَ﴾: postponed fāʿil (agent); the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of عينا.

daas-irab:29-29.t: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾: inna and its noun; ﴿أَجْرَمُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين; ﴿كانُوا﴾: kāna and its noun; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the clause إن الذين… is resumptive; ﴿مِنَ الَّذِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يضحكون; ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its agent; the clause is the ṣila of الذين; ﴿يَضْحَكُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its agent; the clause is the khabar of كانوا.

daas-irab:30-30.t: ﴿وَإِذا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿إِذا﴾: a conditional adverb that does not put the verb in the jussive; ﴿مَرُّوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿بِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is in the position of a genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿يَتَغامَزُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), the wāw being its agent; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:31-31.t: ﴿وَإِذَا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿إِذَا﴾: a conditional adverb that does not put the verb in the jussive; ﴿انْقَلَبُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿إِلى أَهْلِهِمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) what precedes them; the clause is in the position of a genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); ﴿انْقَلَبُوا﴾: a past verb and its agent; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) and has no grammatical position; ﴿فَكِهِينَ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:32-32.t: ﴿وَإِذا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿إِذا﴾: a conditional adverb that does not put the verb in the jussive; ﴿رَأَوْهُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is in the position of a genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its agent; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) and has no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّ هؤُلاءِ لَضالُّونَ﴾: inna and its noun, and the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿لَضالُّونَ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of inna; the clause is the maqūl (speech content) of the saying.

daas-irab:33-33.t: ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿ما﴾: negative; ﴿أُرْسِلُوا﴾: a passive past verb, the wāw being the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; ﴿حافِظِينَ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:34-34.t: ﴿فَالْيَوْمَ﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle and ﴿اليوم﴾ is an adverb of time; ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause); ﴿مِنَ الْكُفَّارِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) what follows them; ﴿يَضْحَكُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), the wāw being its agent; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:35-35.t: ﴿عَلَى الْأَرائِكِ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) what follows them; ﴿يَنْظُرُونَ﴾: the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:36-36.t: ﴿هَلْ﴾: an interrogative particle; ﴿ثُوِّبَ﴾: a passive past verb; ﴿الْكُفَّارُ﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the maqūl (speech content) of an omitted verb of saying; ﴿ما﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿كانُوا﴾: kāna and its noun; ﴿يَفْعَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), the wāw being its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا, and the clause كانوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما.
